text.p: Baxter International Inc said Thursday it has purchased additional shares of Immuno International AG for $161 million and now controls more than 99 percent of the voting and capital interest in the company.
The combined companies will create the world's largest blood products manufacturer.
In the third step of a proposed transaction, Baxter purchased 184,780 bearer shares and 410,000 registered shares of Immuno for $161 million.
The total value of the acquisition is about $600 million.

A definitive agreement signed on August 28, 1996, provided that Baxter would purchase the remaining shares from private shareholders of Immuno. Baxter said it is continuing its efforts to acquire the few remaining outstanding shares.
Baxter shares were trading up 7/16 to 54-7/8.
